journey.name: Suggest Story Edit and Submit
journey.description: Verifies that a user can open the Suggest Edits screen for a story, modify fields (e.g. Origin Story or Notes), submit the edit suggestion, and receive positive submission confirmation.

actions.action: Verify that the app is on the "Discover" feed
Scroll until the app story "Xperiencia" is visible
Verify that the story detail screen for "Xperiencia" is displayed
Scroll down and tap the "✏️ Suggest Edits" button
Verify that the "Suggest Edits" screen is displayed with prefilled fields
Scroll down to the "Note to Reviewer (Optional)" field
Type "Updated revenue milestone and verified Play Store listing" into the "Note to Reviewer (Optional)" field
Verify that the confirmation screen displays "Suggestion Submitted! 🎉"
Verify that the message "Thank you for contributing. An admin will review your suggested edits shortly." is visible
Verify that the app returns to the "Xperiencia" story detail screen
